# Marketer Raja

Marketer Raja is a performance-driven digital marketing and lead generation agency based in Sankari, Salem, Tamil Nadu, India. It helps businesses grow through SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, web development, and lead generation.

## Services
- [SEO Services](https://www.marketerraja.com/seo/): Search engine optimisation, technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and local search visibility.
- [Google Ads](https://www.marketerraja.com/google-ads/): Google advertising campaigns for lead generation.
- [Meta Ads](https://www.marketerraja.com/meta-ads/): Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.
- [Web & App Development](https://www.marketerraja.com/web-development/): Website and application development.
